title: Model behavior follows model definitions
summary:
A text-generation cleanup put model behavior in model definitions, made transforms fall back safely, and retired old paths.

Text generation now reads provider names and system-message support from each model’s configuration. DeepSeek Reasoning is marked as not supporting system messages; Qwen Coder and Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite now specify their provider model names explicitly.

Model transforms can now be composed with pipe, addTools and overrideModel. If a transform fails, generation falls back to the original messages and options.

The Azure o4-mini configuration has its own key, the gpt-4.1-nano alias was removed from openai-fast, and legacy search and OptiLLM generator modules were removed.
